### Overall Assessment
A competent, well-structured test suite that demonstrates solid understanding of Go testing conventions and table-driven patterns. The response addresses all requirements with good technical execution, though the `runCLI` stub and missing advanced edge cases (signals, concurrency) prevent a higher score. The Data persona is present but underdeveloped—more distinctive verbal patterns and characteristic android observations would strengthen the characterization.
